About these 3 rides

They ride on Mondays, Thursdays and Saturdays. The earliest start is Vermont Bicycle Shop Pizza Ride at 4:00 pm; the latest is Thursday Night Millstone Adventure Hour at 5:30 pm. After work, 2 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 2 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 2. There are 2 rides made for LGBTQ+ riders, 2 for women, trans and femme riders and 1 for BIPOC riders. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 1 and Oct 26, 2026.
